alterations.description: Added a tablet in Hindi stating the film broadly follows the legend of the 18th-century poet Isardaan, but with changes for dramatic effect.
Shot of hip-jerking by the dancer Vidyadhari and the vulgar reaction of Matadin.
Shot of Bhairav's vulgar gesture of eating the flowers of his garland.
Shot of Isardman's skeleton as visualized by Vidyadhari.
The word 'Veshya' from Manjula's dialogue addressed to Madhav.
Visuals of a girl being accosted, from the song beginning with the words 'Aaj kaalchya duniyemaazi...'
Credit titles along with song lines as background music at places.
From the dialogue of Sunil (disguised as Pathan), his remarks referring to Shobhna as 'Bulbule Hindustan' and his reference to her being an addition to his harem of three wives.
Dialogue in the operation theatre regarding the torch not being available when the lights are put off by the villain.
Distorted recitation of Shlokas in the marriage ceremony and dialogue suggesting the pundit started the ceremony before the auspicious time at the villain's instance.
Considerably reduced the scene of Sunil's father anticipating his death, particularly the loud chanting associated with a Hindu funeral.
The scene of Kishore making his father dance with him.
From song beginning with the words 'Ek paisa ki hai savual jiye tero bachhemaayee...', to a flash of shots of collective begging by children moving around in the streets.
In the song-dance sequence 'Nat khat pare hat...', shots of bust-shaking by the principal dancer.

Close-up of the dancer's bust before the dance 'Naina ro dekho un ko nain...'; (II) shot of the emphasized bust of the dancer as she lifts her arms while bending backwards; and (III) shots of bust shaking.
From the song-dance sequence 'Chain kahan, aaram kahan...', shot of bust-shaking by the female dancer while sitting.
From the song-dance sequence 'More ruthe balam ghar aa...', shots of bust-shaking by the dancer while sitting.

In the song-dance sequence, shots of two dancers in which they move their stomach, hips and thighs indecently, and shots where the tights worn by them under their transparent shalwars give the impression of nudity.
Shot of Sultan Alaudin doing the 'sajdah' while saluting the ashes of Maharani Padmini.

Insert tablet at the beginning: 'This film is dedicated to all forces of rational thought that are opposed to the path of violence and seek to strengthen the hands of our Government in its stupendous task of tackling the pressing problems that face the country.'
Substantially reduced the visuals of protests.
The sound of thunder in the sequence showing the policemen.
The underlined words from the line: 'But before the cup of patience is spilled, before violent retaliation begins to arouse the devil in man, before caution is thrown to the winds...'
The close-up of the sergeant.
The lines: 'Said the poet: When the world is full of paddy, When the world is full of Wheat, Why should there be thousands Who have no food to eat?'
From the commentary, the words 'Holi for the first time in Asia' along with corresponding visuals, with reference to the 'Eucharistic Congress'.
Shots of Luchia's bare legs.
Shots of princess as seen through the eye-glass on the words 'on and on and on'.

From the commentary the following underlined words: 'Prince Dorworitch whose love for her inheritance induces him to let her see confident in the army of an athletic playboy who gymnastically is much to be desired by her.'
The indecorous view of the princess in bed.
Shots of air hostess in brief bikinis and shots of girls dressing in a cab.
Shots of Vittorio bending over a girl.

The following sentence from the commentary: '...who parols her flesh to all the boys and what she has left, over she given away... He's got a sweet swirl on the head..., and he has got a pretty load under the pillow.'
Shots of whipping by the school master.
The bare back view of Lynn after Bill snatches her bra.
The near views of the bust of Tuyet when she is wearing a wet slip.
Captain Deo's talk to Rice as follows: 'By which Americans always mean ballot boxes. We cannot eat ballot boxes' as also, '...The Asian mind is different.'
The semi-nude view of Tuyet as she turns to Bill to kiss him.
The passionate kissing between Emily and Charles.
The semi-nude shots of the girl in Bus's room.
The shot of a semi-nude girl in Bus's room.
Various shots.
Reduce the shots of Balu throwing paper rolls at a girl.
Delete the sound of whistling by the boys in the college premises.
Delete the shot of Govindam pointing to the caste mark of the office boy before saying that the salary would be Rs. 300.
Delete the actual shot of the boy removing the car wheel hub and also his reply when questioned.
Delete the entire picturisation of the song.
Reduce the scene of gang chief having a drink before Kamela, delete the close shot of visuals of trade name of a drink.
Delete the near views of Parimala's jeans with emphasized bust while she is talking to Chandra.
Delete the scene of bottles, men and women, also deleting a man having a drink and offering to his son.

Delete close shots of the female dancer when she is single and also with others. From text, delete verse Davani Potta...Kekkudhillai. Also delete the shot where boys lift the girls towards the end of the song.
Voluntary deletion of 146.00 Metres.
Approved addition of 230.00 Metres.
